findingClosed: The actual guarded custody capability omitted chainId, so original collateral/Bok refund prepare rejected before any send. Returning normalized chainId after the existing live chain/address/context guard supplies the already-verified identity required by the withdrawal capability.
failurePaths: Chain/address/account/transport/context guards unchanged and still re-run at confirmation and actual send.
Frozen capability exposes normalized chain string only; it adds no signing authority, network request, or replay behavior.
Original canonical L2 exit, Ethereum journal, gas cap and finality guards remain unchanged.

checks.regressionSemantics: Actual captureRollingFundingWallet composed with actual createCollateralWithdrawal and encrypted journal; controlled EIP1193/node/Ethereum provider. Both collateral and Bok prepare succeed without send, chain switch before confirm rejects without send.

limitations: No actual financial transaction or wallet browser acceptance inferred from controlled checks. Updated served immutable wallet manifest requires the owner-managed restart.
